Admin Dashboard

Abbreviations used on this page (TSDB, WAL, TTL, HWM, XPUB, ZMQ, SQLite, JSON, CLI, API, RSS, fd, PEP, CORS, OBS...) are defined in the Abbreviations & jargon section.

The service ships a live admin page that shows what the backend is doing: service health, ingest and query rates, active connections, subscriber topics, storage state, and a live event feed. It is served by the gateway itself, so it always reflects the instance you are looking at.

Viewing

Open the HTTP gateway port in a browser (default 12505, follows your config):

http://127.0.0.1:12505/dashboard

Same-origin means its WebSockets connect to the same host and port — no CORS setup, no extra process, and it keeps working behind the systemd unit unchanged. The page layout follows the Light Bootstrap Dashboard template (Creative Tim, MIT, vendored under src/sqtseries/gateway/static/vendor/); its CSS and JS are separate local files with no external requests.

What it shows

PanelSource
Service strip (status, uptime, version, database, ports, WAL)snapshot + 1s tick
Ingest (points/sec, totals, invalid, errors)tick deltas (ZMQ + HTTP paths both counted)
Queries (rate, totals, cache hit ratio and size)tick deltas
Connections (id, peer, topic, activity age, stale flag)snapshot + live events, newest first
Topics (every known topic, live subscriber counts, per-topic point totals)snapshot + 1s tick
Storage (series, metrics, partitions, backups, rollup watermark)snapshot + tick
Events ticker (joins, leaves, subscribes)live events, newest first

Push protocol

The page opens ws://host:port/ws/dashboard and never polls (HTTP admin stays as the fallback if the socket drops):

  • First frame: {"type":"snapshot",...} — counters, lists, storage state, server_time.
  • Then: {"type":"conn",...} / {"type":"sub",...} frames pushed the moment the registry changes (same hook the stats publisher uses), plus a {"type":"tick",...} with fresh counters every second.
  • Snapshot and tick assembly runs off the event loop; the event queue is bounded (500) so a stalled browser cannot grow server memory; the registry listener is unhooked on disconnect.

Raw access to the same feed: /ws/connections (snapshot plus per-change frames) and the admin connections / subscribers commands documented in API Reference. The Topics panel lists every topic the service has ever seen — idle topics stay visible with a 0 count — alongside each topic's total published points (GET /api/v1/subscribers returns the same topics list as JSON).
